title: Static Review and farm QA request interface
description: Real Chrome controls and an isolated production gateway prove inherited farm execution, team inference, review-machine overrides, farm QA profile selection and distinct persisted requests. Requests remain unstarted.

request-interface.intent: Submit Review and QA through real browser controls; prove publication inheritance/opt-out, QA exclusion, persisted choices, run receipt/error display, retry refusal and live run-update events with gateway reads and screenshots.
